name: Project 1 Home SOC - detection coverage
description: Techniques emulated in the lab and detected in Elastic. T1059.001, T1136.001 and T1053.005: Atomic Red Team against CLIENT01, Sigma rules, host telemetry. T1071.001 and T1071.004: custom beacon and DNS-tunnelling simulations, Suricata and Zeek network telemetry. Dark green = detection validated against lab telemetry, with an incident report. Light green = detected and written up, but part of the tuning is not yet validated.

techniques.comment: IR-2026-001. Encoded PowerShell: alias-aware regex plus WmiPrvSE.exe parent clause. Sysmon EID 1.
IR-2026-002. Local account creation: Security 4720 (primary) plus Sysmon net.exe /add.
IR-2026-003. Scheduled task: Security 4698 (primary, both schtasks and PowerShell cmdlet routes) plus Sysmon schtasks /create.
IR-2026-003. Scheduled task: Security 4698 (primary, both schtasks and PowerShell cmdlet routes) plus Sysmon schtasks /create.

IR-2026-004. Simulated HTTP beacon (30 requests, ~60 s, jitter): Suricata signature (sid 1000001) and Zeek http/conn telemetry on ELK01. Interval-regularity detection is a hunt script over Zeek conn.log, not a SIEM rule; threshold supported by one beacon and five baseline pairs.

IR-2026-004 section 9. Simulated DNS tunnelling (two runs of 40 queries): Zeek dns and Suricata DNS telemetry on ELK01. Rule: single label of 40+ characters, tested in ES|QL; it also matched six benign Windows TPM attestation names (labels 50 and 53 chars vs the tunnel's 52), so a narrow exclusion was added. Fan-out hunt (6 benign vs 40 tunnel names under one parent) not re-checked over the full window. Exclusion and Sigma-to-Elastic conversion untested; benign sample about 158 names.
